common_domain.periodic_cover: The phase box [-4,4]^7 contains [-pi,pi]^7. All 14 coefficient targets are 2pi-periodic in q or constant (joint H derivatives). This bounds coefficient functions; it changes no physical joint limit.
common_domain.conditional_T_and_K_coverage: Any feasible tightened plan has |vp|+chi_v+delta_v<=vmax, hence its T velocities are physical and chi_v<=vmax. Markov bounds on every degree-five span plus Lambda*vmax cover qr_ddot in K. A failing tightened-speed screen never establishes coverage or planner feasibility.
common_domain.Markov_derivation: On [-1,1], ||p2||<=200||p|| and ||p3||<=840||p|| for degree5. Rescale a span and center q: ap<=400*width/L^2; jerk<=3360*width/L^3.
common_domain.training_anchors: Four previously measured v4 C4 starts and original physical midpoint, each a=0; included before tests, not chosen for success.

final_policy: Existing alpha_v10 policy; lambda=5, kappa=10, Ko=20, alpha1=alpha2=5, disturbance and all physical bounds unchanged.
estimate_method: First 512 points of fixed Sobol(21, scramble, seed20271102) power10 set, plus four previously measured C4 starts and physical midpoint; next256 points held out. Final tables retain training extrema even when holdout exceeds. No inflation factor or sampled minimum promoted to certified bound.
inertia_lower_bound: Exact rational body inertia SPD/inverse-trace lemma and kinematic energy proof, divided by4; selected ideal model only, full floating evaluation not Level1.
AD_validation: Central finite differences step1e-6; rtol3e-5 atol2e-7, new derivative diagnostic only; existing experimental thresholds unchanged.
domain_rationale: Global periodic coefficient cover [-4,4]^7 (physical limits unchanged); physical velocity box conditional on tightened speed feasibility; augmented acceleration from Markov degree5 bounds using unchanged Tmin and knot spans plus Lambda*vmax.
G2_5_screen: 12 unchanged E1/E2/E3 reference/C4-start cases, 101 nodes on original .01s NLP initial grid. Evaluate complete margins, including rho_r(0)=varpi0 and factor-two terms; 43 filter constraints, torque reserves, speed, position/manipulability h, HOCBF, velocity CBF; source-derived residual Lipschitz estimates remain uncertified.
fixed_start_impossibility_witness: Exact inverse of represented M and rational speed-pair Farkas weights1/2+1/2; not an exact nonlinear model or Level1 certificate.
